annotations.title: Refund status of a checkout session

description:
Says whether the payment behind a create_checkout_link session was refunded, how much and why. Status: not_paid (nothing to refund), none (paid, not refunded), requested (a refund is under way), under_review (an unused non-USPS label, decided by an operator), declined (the label was scanned, so the carrier refused the refund), partially_refunded or refunded; with amount_paid, amount_refunded, reason (unused_label: the automatic refund of a never-scanned label; other) and the refund policy in force. Unused USPS labels are refunded automatically; this tool only reads, it never starts a refund. SMKlog records only: no carrier call, no quote allowance.

Parameter rules:
- session_id is the as_ plus UUID id from create_checkout_link; no order id or email works.
- An unknown, malformed or expired id answers session_not_found.
- It reports on the checkout get_checkout_status reports.
- No names, addresses, emails or card details.
- 60 checks an hour per client, shared with get_checkout_status.
name: get_refund_status

outputSchema.description: Where the refund of the payment behind this session stands, from SMKlog order records.

next.description: What, if anything, the agent should do now

order_id.description: SMKlog order id, the reference for support; null before checkout

requested_at.description: When the automatic unused-label refund was requested, ISO 8601
